events.label: Site-wide event capture
events.help: Records what shoppers do — pages seen, searches, WhatsApp taps, bag changes, purchases and more — in the shop's own database, so the Analytics section can show what is working and what is not. Nothing here depends on an outside service or a connection key. On as it ships; turning it off stops new events from being recorded (nothing already saved is removed, CLAUDE.md rule 3).
